name: spiderbrain

tools.name: sb_blast
tools.description: What a change to a file reaches (its transitive dependents / blast radius), computed deterministically from the committed graph.

tools.name: sb_impact
tools.description: What a CHANGE SET reaches: the union blast of several changed files, plus which changed files are keystones. Use before/while editing to know the consequences.

paths.description: repo-relative paths of the changed files

tools.name: sb_path
tools.description: The shortest dependency path between two files: how does one reach the other (import chain or dependent chain).

tools.name: sb_keystones
tools.description: The load-bearing files, ranked by how many files they reach.

tools.name: sb_map
tools.description: What a file is, what it depends on, and what depends on it.

tools.name: sb_ask
tools.description: Ask about the repo. Structure is answered offline; the why-layer needs a SpiderBrain API key.
